about_the_game:
"Welcome to the end. My end."

Project ReMind is a first-person story-driven puzzle and adventure game. Explore forgotten worlds, manipulate intricate machines and strange computers, solve hidden riddles and uncover deeply seeded mysteries, as you piece together a life that starts in the present day, and takes you through to the dawn of the 22nd Century. The game combines exploration and adventure with dozens of uniquely crafted puzzles. With a focus on intricate interaction and spatial storytelling, the player is invited to immerse themselves in a deeply personal and lovingly constructed single-player experience.

Engage your mind with a series of intricate puzzles built into the environment. Manipulate complex machinery, decipher cryptic computer logs, and reactivate the dormant technology of your past life. Each solution requires keen observation and critical thinking, pulling you deeper into your own memories.

Put yourself to the test, all while encountering pieces of your forgotten life scattered throughout the island. Each puzzle brings you one step closer to the truth... or perhaps, you are forgetting something hidden behind the veils of your mind. Aren’t you?

Encounter echoes and shards of a forgotten life that will guide you toward the final truth. But as you reassemble the past, a chilling question emerges: can you remember who you are? What was your life like?

Even in solitude, you’ll bear witness to echoes of a past that no longer holds sway over you. The images and echoes of a long-forgotten past will guide you toward understanding why you’re here, but remember—nothing is as it seems. You’ve already lost the path long ago… or have you?"

You will find yourself in a world that seems to be made up of memories, rather than places. Taken in alone, these memories might just be snapshots of the 21st Century's progress through the decades, as humanity grapples with its own destiny and identity. But there's something deeper that binds these memories together; a question that shouldn't exist. A possibility that challenges our notions of reality. A life's work that has yet to be finished. As you recover the forgotten story of these memories, you will piece together a mystery that could take humanity to a frontier beyond our very wildest dreams.

Over two hours of hand-crafted, live-recorded music by Felix Wilson, performed on real theremin, analogue synths, lush strings, woodwinds, and unique percussion. The score evolves and reshapes itself as you play; layering, remixing, and reacting to your presence, no two moments ever sound the same. A living, breathing soundscape draws you deeper into your search for the truth.

Features

  • Solve Intricate puzzles

  • Discover a Fractured Past

  • Explore Dreamlike environment

  • Original Soundtrack

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU @ 3.0 GHz (AMD Ryzen 7, Intel core i5/i7)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU @ 3.0 GHz (AMD Ryzen 7, Intel core i5/i7)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 6700xt, GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.
